scope_introduction_evidence: Pinned source L187; w-local spectral space
summary: A spectral space is w-local iff its closed points form a closed subset and every point specializes to a unique closed point. A continuous map of w-local spaces is w-local iff spectral and closed-points preserving.

summary: A→B is a local isomorphism when for each q∈Spec B some g∉q makes Spec B_g→Spec A an open immersion; it identifies local rings when A_{q∩A}→B_q is an isomorphism for all q.
